newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, nickel metals fall, others steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, nickel metals fall, others steady.

text.p: Copper prices fell on the Indian market as state-owned agencies increased offerings and nickel fell as local stockist unloaded inventory, dealers said.
Other base metals were steady in a narrow price band amid limited activity.
Copper prices fell by 50 rupees to 13,450 per quintal reflecting the agencies' offers in a market lacking physical demand. World market prices remained weak.
Copper fell 25 rupees on Tuesday, the market was closed on Wednesday for a Hindu festival.

Nickel declined a further 200 rupees to 35,800 per quintal on the back of fresh unloading by the local stockist amid negligible demand. But some traders were expecting prices to bounce back looking at the recovery in the world market.
Nickel was down by 300 rupees per quintal on Tuesday.

Tin was steady at the reduced level of 31,000 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees on Tuesday while aluminium was steady at 7,450 rupees. Zinc was steady at 7,850 rupees, as was lead at 4,550 rupees per quintal amid limited activity.
